component.name: Sheet
component.description: Slide-in panel overlay from any screen edge with header, body, and footer slots.

slots.name: overlay
slots.description: Backdrop layer rendered behind the sheet panel.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Slide-in panel containing header, body, footer, and close control.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-describedby
ariaAttributes.description: References descriptive text associated with the control.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-label
ariaAttributes.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-labelledby
ariaAttributes.description: References the element that labels the control or region.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-modal
ariaAttributes.description: Identifies modal content that traps interaction outside the dialog.

ariaAttributes.name: role
ariaAttributes.description: Defines the semantic role exposed to assistive technology.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Top region for sheet title and description.

slots.name: wrapper
slots.description: Inner wrapper that arranges sheet header, body, footer, and actions.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text associated with the sheet title.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Header action region, usually paired with the close control.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the component, slot, or item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present when the component or async operation is loading.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-busy
ariaAttributes.description: Accessibility attribute forwarded by the rendered component.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-label
ariaAttributes.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

own.name: action
own.description: Additional action elements to render in the header.

own.name: ariaLabel
own.description: Accessible name used when the sheet has no rendered title.

own.name: body
own.description: Custom element to render in the scrollable body slot.

own.name: children
own.description: Render the sheet trigger as a single HTMLElement root.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: close
own.description: Whether to show a close button, or a custom element to use as one.

own.name: defaultOpen
own.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

own.name: description
own.description: Secondary description displayed below the title.

own.name: dismissible
own.description: Whether outside interaction and Escape should dismiss the shell.

own.name: footer
own.description: Custom element to render in the footer slot.

own.name: header
own.description: Custom element to render in the header slot.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier used to derive the content id.

own.name: inset
own.description: Whether to inset the sheet from the viewport on larger screens.

own.name: onClosePrevent
own.description: Called when a dismissal attempt is blocked.

own.name: onExitComplete
own.description: Called after the modal has fully finished its exit motion.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

own.name: open
own.description: Controlled open state.

own.name: overlay
own.description: Whether to render the overlay element.

own.name: ref
own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["span"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined

own.name: side
own.description: Edge of the viewport from which the sheet enters.

own.name: title
own.description: Primary title displayed in the sheet header.

own.name: transition
own.description: Whether to enable transition animations.
